description: Meta-node invisibility: a node with is_meta=true and its descendant subtree are invisible to formula resolution and skipped by positional operators (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §2, §6 item 9).

cases.name: a name that exists only inside a meta subtree is Unresolved
cases.note: Secret lives under Section.Config (is_meta=true), so it is not reachable from formulas; walk-up skips meta subtrees.

cases.name: @PREV skips a meta sibling
cases.note: Sibling order under Section is [Rate, Config(meta), Item]; @PREV from Item skips meta Config and lands on Rate.
